turns.query: For futures-only CFTC 10-year Treasury note contract 043602 report dates from 2021-2025, inner-join exact same-date Treasury 2- and 10-year yields and SOFR. Define leveraged-money net share as long minus short divided by open interest. Report aligned count/boundaries and select the minimum 10-year-minus-2-year spread, ties earlier, with spread, SOFR and net share. Carry the weekly panel and interpret the relationship and material scope of the curve and positioning measures.

Through 2023-12-31, estimate by OLS the normalized long-run relation with 10-year yield dependent on an intercept, 2-year yield and SOFR. On its residual, estimate by OLS an intercept-bearing no-lag ADF regression of residual change on lagged residual; compute the coefficient standard error using residual sum of squares divided by observations minus two. Report count, long-run coefficients, residual n-1 standard deviation, ADF level coefficient and t statistic. Carry the normalized residual forward and interpret what this Engle-Granger-style diagnostic can and cannot license about cointegration.

Estimate the conditional rank-one error-correction equation for weekly 10-year-yield change on an intercept, lagged equilibrium error, contemporaneous 2-year-yield change and contemporaneous SOFR change. Report count, coefficients, R-squared and maximum absolute unscaled OLS normal-equation moment. Carry coefficients forward and interpret adjustment sign and contemporaneous-information limits.

Freeze coefficients and evaluate 2024-2025 conditional one-step changes using realized contemporaneous regressors versus a no-change random walk. Report count, both RMSEs and whether ECM is lower. Identify largest absolute actual-minus-predicted error, ties earlier, and report date/error and same-date leveraged-money net share. Interpret forecast-information and positioning-overlay limits.
